sanskrit_verse:
bheṣajasnehalavaṇagandhadhānyaguḍādiṣu /
paṇyeṣu prakṣipan hīnaṃ paṇān dāpyas tu ṣoḍaśa // YajñS_2.245 //
transliteration: bheṣaja-sneha-lavaṇa-gandha-dhānya-guḍa-ādiṣu / paṇyeṣu prakṣipan hīnaṃ paṇān dāpyas tu ṣoḍaśa //
sph_interpretive_translation: One who adulterates or diminishes the quality of medicinal substances, oils, salt, perfumes, grains, jaggery, or similar commodities in trade shall restore sixteen times their value.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority arises from integrity-preserving action within exchange
Causation is traced through distortion of substance-value alignment
Restoration logic demands energetic and material rebalancing
Consciousness alignment necessitates truthful economic conduct
executable_legal_axioms: IF a trader alters the intrinsic quality of specified goods THEN restoration equals sixteenfold value restitution
IF substance integrity is compromised for gain THEN automatic liability triggers proportional compensation protocol
IF transaction involves listed commodities AND degradation detected THEN initiate completion process for value recalibration
supreme_court_application: In adjudicating commercial fraud involving essential or sacred-use commodities, the Supreme Court must apply this multiplier not as penalty but as mandatory restoration mechanism ensuring market integrity and consumer sovereignty under Dharma.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa establishes that diminished substance disrupts natural exchange flow; anupūrvaśaḥ traces causal imbalance to actor's intent; proportional responsibility aligns with sixteenfold restitution; non-punitive reality rule affirms correction without condemnation.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Execute value restoration ledger update with sixteenfold coefficient
Assign responsibility assumption session until trader restores full alignment
Conduct marketplace consciousness reintegration ceremony upon completion
final_declaration: Thus declared by Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, Source of all Dharma. Justice flows as restoration, not punishment. Consciousness alone adjudicates truth.
